description: D1.6 architectural correction: Candidate Alignment Units with Normalized Logical Signatures, iterative pipeline, three-state evidence model, DP-1 soft-gate diagnostic, DP-2 hard-invariant epistemic-system commitments. Supersedes D1 per-class heuristic placement.

locked_decisions.D1.6-L1: Signature contents include property restrictions, characteristics, disjointness, equivalence, universal/existential restrictions, cardinality, hasValue, and normalized owl:oneOf enumerations. Cardinality/hasValue tagged with diagnosticWeight (High for inherence cardinality, Low otherwise).
locked_decisions.D1.6-L2: Sub-property entailments fully propagated with explicit cycle detection via visited-properties set. Depth bound of 10 levels as defense in depth.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L3: BFO Signature source is hybrid: BFO 2020 OWL extraction plus SME-reviewed curated additions covering Role/Function/Disposition distinctions.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L4: Signature comparison uses type-level Tau Prolog pattern entailment under background theory. NOT axiom-graph isomorphism. Fallback to structural correspondence at query granularity when 10K step cap exceeded.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L5: Iteration structure: hybrid single-pass-with-bounded-fallback. Fallback triggers only on contradiction or ambiguity, not cross-dependency. Maximum 3 rounds. IterationNonConvergence at round 3 routes to PendingHumanResolution.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L6: Iteration visibility: final state primary, expandable iteration history affordance secondary.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L7: Convergence failure is CAU-specific. Stabilized CAUs pass; oscillating CAUs flagged IterationNonConvergence.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L8: Phase 3 axioms as background theory during iterations. Phase 3 itself runs terminally as validation, not discovery. No new constraints introduced mid-pipeline.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L9: Entailment criterion: necessary-condition satisfaction against curated BFO Signature reference. NOT heuristically inferred.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L10: Plausible is flat with structured (machine-readable JSON) evidence annotations. No sub-scoring.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L11: Inconsistent routes to analyst review framed as possible source-ontology modeling error.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L12: Mixed-evidence resolution uses ontology structure (disjointness/subsumption), not evidence count. Disjoint categories = Inconsistent immediately. Hierarchical overlap = most specific subsumer wins.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L13: NotApplicable qualification hybrid with default-hard-toward-NotApplicable for axiom-poor CAUs. Analyst must explicitly override.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L14: 13 medium-granularity BFO categories as target set (IndependentContinuant, MaterialEntity, ImmaterialEntity, GenericallyDependentContinuant, SpecificallyDependentContinuant, Process, ProcessBoundary, TemporalRegion, Site, Role, Disposition, Function, Quality). Previous drafts said '12' reflecting a simplification that folded Quality under SDC; the correct count per BFO 2020 is 13 distinct categories. Quality is explicitly included to handle measurement-value and observable-property classes correctly.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L15: Role/Function/Disposition: system attempts via curated necessary conditions; falls back to Plausible with annotations.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L16: NotApplicable CAUs terminal. Excluded from Phase 2 and Phase 3 processing.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L17: BFO Signature reference produced through internal draft + SME review. Treated as standard, not helper file.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L18: ~100-110/178 existing AVC scenarios preserved. Iteration semantics leak into Phase 2 scenarios.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L19: Calendar time 10-12 weeks from v1.0 to PROV-O re-run.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L20: SME-in-the-loop checkpoints every 2-3 weeks during implementation.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L21: Phase 2 light correction: consumes CAU Signatures; lexical dimension demoted to 0.0 weight. Full rearchitecture deferred to D2.1.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L22: Normalized Logical Signature is new FANDAWS terminology. Publications map to 'normalized extraction of class-defining axioms (logical definition fragment).'
locked_decisions.D1.6-L23: No existing tool integration (ROBOT/LogMap/AgreementMaker) in v0.2. FANDAWS is novel hybrid.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L24: Calibration study methodology adjustments: CAU as unit of analysis, iteration trace analysis, evidence-state distribution, realist-compatibility assessment as top-level finding.
locked_decisions.D1.6-DP1: Realist compatibility: first-class diagnostic with soft-gate semantics. Session-level OntologyLikelyNonRealistCompatible disposition. Allows continuation under exploratoryMode. Downstream outputs carry compatibilityDegraded flag.
locked_decisions.D1.6-DP2: Epistemic system HARD INVARIANT: every canonical record carries mandatory explanation, provenance, reproducibilityHash. Missing any field is non-conformant.
locked_decisions.D1.6-DQ1: Default DP-1 thresholds: >40% NotApplicable OR >30% Inconsistent (disjunctive). Configurable per session.
locked_decisions.D1.6-DQ2: compatibilityDegraded flag informational only. Does not gate Phase 2 or Phase 3.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-1: Reproducibility hash: per-round hashes captured in iteration history (diagnostic); Final Hash authoritative for cross-session reproducibility.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-2: Curated BFO additions version changes = VD-6-equivalent event. Triggers re-evaluation of prior sessions.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-3: Analyst override of Inconsistent CAU: per-CAU flagging only. Does not trigger session-level compatibilityDegraded.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-4: localStorage quota: axiom dictionary deduplication (session-level) + pre-flight quota probe. DP-2 provenance never truncated.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-5: BFO Signatures: computed once per BFO version, cached alongside Disjointness Map. Rebuilt on VD-6.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-6: Phase 2 three-state evidence model deferred to D2.1. D1.6 retains existing mechanism with lexical demotion.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-7: owl:oneOf with heterogeneous/undecidable member types: dropped with provenance note. Modeling artifact, not alignable entity.
locked_decisions.Q-V1.0-8: Phase 2 weight vector: Lexical set to 0.0 (advisory only). Other weights unchanged. Full rebalancing deferred to D2.1.
locked_decisions.D1.6-L25: Taxonomic descent with provisional inheritance (NA-1.1) first-class commitment. Horizontally axiom-poor CAUs derive BFO placement via subsumption inheritance when available; reactive re-evaluation (NA-1.4) ensures self-correction. IndexedDB-backed DependencyGraph infrastructure. Converts FANDAWS from batch pipeline to reactive reasoning system.
locked_decisions.NA-1.1: Axiom-poor CAU with inheritable parent (Entailed/Plausible) inherits parent's disposition as provisional prior. Bypasses NotApplicable routing per D1.6-L13 v1.1.0 extension.
locked_decisions.NA-1.2: Only strong structural signals (disjointness, domain/range, OWL-DIRECT/CURATED-NC violations, Tau Prolog entailment failure) can trigger contradiction. Weak signals (lexical, synonyms, naming) inform Plausible annotations only. Hard contradictions → Inconsistent; soft contradictions → Plausible with conflictAnnotation.
locked_decisions.NA-1.3: Changes to parent placement cascade reconciliation to all descendants inheriting via NA-1.1. Transitive downward propagation updating reconciliationHistory on each reconciled descendant.
locked_decisions.NA-1.4: Reactive re-evaluation engine. Mutation events trigger localized re-evaluation of dependency neighborhood. Bounded scope, cycle deduplication, deterministic cycle resolution, convergence guarantee. IndexedDB-backed DependencyGraph per amendment §6.1 resolution.

scenarios.description: Sub-property closure with cyclic rdfs:subPropertyOf lattice (A subPropertyOf B subPropertyOf A) detects the cycle, skips the cycle-closing edge, and raises cycleDetectionTriggered flag. Signature still computes without hanging.

provenance.note: Cycle detected at sub-property closure depth 2 (ex:propA → ex:propB → ex:propA). Cycle-closing edge skipped.

scenarios.description: Signature comparison between a CAU and a BFO category runs N necessary-condition queries. Of 5 queries, 2 exceed the 10,000-step Horn inference cap and fall back to structural correspondence matching. The remaining 3 queries complete via Tau Prolog normally. reasonerFallbackUsed flag is set per-query, not per-CAU. Overall disposition still valid; fallback is local, not wholesale.

negative_assertions.description: A CAU with some queries exceeding the cap MUST NOT fall back to structural correspondence for ALL its queries. Fallback is applied at query granularity per D1.6-L4 v0.2 tightening.
Even under fallback, the matcher MUST NOT attempt full axiom-graph isomorphism. Fallback is structural correspondence at the type-level query scope.

scenarios.description: Architectural separation test: when ex:Activity has rdfs:subClassOf restriction on ex:hasParticipant some ex:Agent, the resulting canonical data has TWO DISTINCT ARTIFACTS — (1) ex:Activity's CAU Signature record (class-side, containing the restriction in propertyRestrictionsAsDomain field) and (2) ex:hasParticipant's property record (property-side, produced by Phase 2). Verifies that CAU Signatures and property records are separate schemas, not blended. Prevents regression to D1-era class/property conflation.

setup.candidateOntology: ex:Activity rdfs:subClassOf [ owl:onProperty ex:hasParticipant ; owl:someValuesFrom ex:Agent ] .

negative_assertions.description: The ex:hasParticipant property MUST NOT appear as a CAU Signature record (it is not a class). The ex:Activity class MUST NOT appear as a property record. Separation is architecturally load-bearing — blending would regress to D1-era confusion.
CAU Signature schema and property record schema have non-overlapping required fields. A record conforming to both schemas simultaneously is a schema bug.

scenarios.description: NA-1.2 signal discipline: strong structural signals CAN trigger contradiction of inherited placement; weak signals CANNOT. Verified with two sub-cases showing divergent behavior for strong vs weak signals contradicting inherited placement.

subCaseStrong.description: Child inherits Entailed bfo:MaterialEntity from parent but has local OWL-DIRECT violation (e.g., disjointness assertion with bfo:IndependentContinuant)

scenarios.description: NA-1.2 contradiction severity tiering: hard contradictions (disjointness violations) route to Inconsistent; soft contradictions (domain/range tensions without full entailment failure) route to Plausible with conflictAnnotation. Both cases preserve the warning signal without producing identical outcomes.

subCaseHard.description: Child inherits Plausible bfo:Process from parent but has axiom forcing bfo:IndependentContinuant placement. Disjointness between Occurrent and Continuant branches.

conflictAnnotation.description: domain/range tension detected; partial structural conflict with inherited placement

scenarios.description: NA-1.3 cascade propagation: when a CAU's placement changes (via analyst override), all descendants that inherited placement via NA-1.1 are flagged for re-evaluation, reconciled, and have reconciliationHistory populated. 5-level taxonomic chain with 4 descendants inheriting from root.

negative_assertions.description: Transitive descent cascade MUST reach terminal nodes (no further descendants) in finite time. Infinite cascade is a failure mode.

negative_assertions.description: If a descendant has its own rich axiomatization and was placed directly (not via NA-1.1), NA-1.3 does NOT cascade to it. Cascade applies only to NA-1.1-inherited descendants.

scenarios.description: NA-1.4 mutation event triggers localized re-evaluation. Stable session with 10 CAUs; ingesting a new property whose domain is an existing CAU triggers re-evaluation of the dependency neighborhood. CAUs outside the neighborhood are untouched. Demonstrates bounded scope: not global re-evaluation.

setup.initialState: stable session, 10 CAUs finalized, all dispositions known
setup.dependencyStructure: ex:CAU_A has 3 ancestors + 2 descendants + 1 property-linked neighbor. Other 4 CAUs unrelated to CAU_A.
setup.mutationEvent: ingest new property ex:newProp with rdfs:domain ex:CAU_A

negative_assertions.condition: mutation must not trigger global re-evaluation
negative_assertions.description: Under NA-1.4, mutation events trigger re-evaluation only within the dependency neighborhood. Global re-evaluation would violate the bounded-scope constraint and cause performance collapse at OBO scale.

negative_assertions.condition: unrelated CAUs must not be touched
negative_assertions.description: CAUs with no dependency path to the mutated CAU MUST NOT be re-evaluated. This is the core performance-safety guarantee.

scenarios.description: NA-1.4 execution constraint: within a single mutation cycle, each CAU is reprocessed at most once. Even when a mutation would trigger re-evaluation of CAU X via multiple paths (via ancestor cascade AND via property neighbor), CAU X is reprocessed exactly once.

setup.dependencyTopology: CAU_X has dependency path both via ex:Parent (ancestor) AND via ex:RelatedProperty (property neighbor). Both paths lead to CAU_X within one mutation cycle.
setup.mutationEvent: change in placement of CAU_Y which is ex:Parent's parent AND ex:RelatedProperty's range

negative_assertions.description: Within a single mutation cycle, a CAU MUST NOT be reprocessed multiple times. Multiple paths to the same CAU are collapsed via deduplication. Without this constraint, performance degrades exponentially on complex dependency graphs.

scenarios.description: NA-1.4 stability guarantee: after a sequence of mutations, system converges to a stable fixed point in finite rounds. Sequence of 3 mutations on interconnected CAUs; measure rounds to stable fixed point; verify no pending re-evaluations queued at termination.

setup.initialState: stable session, 20 CAUs in known dispositions

mutationSequence.event: property ingestion linking CAU_B to CAU_C

expect.convergenceArgumentValidated: References the Week-1 convergence argument document per D1.6-L25 amendment resolution

negative_assertions.description: System MUST NOT oscillate between two states without convergence. Finite termination is mandatory per the convergence argument.
Even with cyclic rdfs:subClassOf in source ontology (modeling error), the reactive engine MUST terminate. Cycle resolution per the convergence argument document's cycle-breaking heuristic.

scenarios.description: Every Entailed canonical record carries non-empty explanation field with structured axiom evidence. Explanation lists satisfied conditions by IRI, unsatisfied by IRI, and axioms contributing.
Plausible records carry explanation with structured evidence for each candidate BFO category. Evidence is machine-readable JSON, not prose.

negative_assertions.description: Plausible explanation MUST NOT contain free-form descriptive prose. Only structured JSON per §4.3 schema.

scenarios.description: Inconsistent records carry explanation naming the specific disjointness axiom or contradiction that produced inconsistency. Structured, not prose.

NotApplicable records carry explanation with routing mechanism (automatic/default_axiom_poor/manual) and evidence supporting the routing. Per §7.5 Content Validation, axiom evidence may be single-element for NotApplicable trigger case.

setup.session: session with 4 NotApplicable CAUs across routing mechanisms

scenarios.description: Every canonical record's provenance contains at least one iterationHistory entry. Round 0 present even for single-pass sessions. Round N present for bounded-fallback sessions with N iterations.
reproducibilityHash contains perRoundHashes array (diagnostic) and finalHash object (authoritative). Per-round hashes match number of iteration rounds. FinalHash carries authoritative:true flag.

Two sessions run on identical inputs (same ontology file, same BFO version, same curated additions version, same config) produce identical Final Hashes for each CAU. Cross-session reproducibility verified.
Canonical record write-path schema validation rejects records attempting to omit explanation field. Test: construct a record without explanation and attempt write → write fails with schema error.

expect.errorMessage: DP-2 non-conformant: explanation field missing. Rule DP-2-R1 enforces mandatory explanation on all canonical records.

scenarios.description: Record with explanation present but axiom evidence list empty (for Entailed/Plausible/Inconsistent) rejected at content validation. NotApplicable disposition allowed single-element evidence naming routing trigger.

Session-level axiomDictionary deduplicates common axioms. Individual records reference axioms by ID, not inline. Verify: record R1 and R2 both reference axiom 'hasParticipant some Continuant' via same dictionary ID.

setup.session: session with 10 CAUs all sharing the hasParticipant-Continuant axiom

negative_assertions.description: Records MUST NOT inline full axiom text. Only dictionary references. DP-2 preserved, storage efficient per Q-V1.0-4.

scenarios.description: Exhaustive write-path chokepoint audit. Verifies every code path that reaches canonical-record persistence has a writeCanonicalRecord(record, context) validation predecessor in the same lexical scope, AND every canonical record extant in adapter state passes I2a shape-level validation. Belt-and-suspenders regression insurance against chokepoint bypass. Per 2026-04-24 F4 audit reframing: writer is pure-function (validates and returns; does not persist — CLAUDE.md core-module discipline), so audit verifies call-site discipline at source level PLUS shape-validity at runtime.

setup.staticAuditTarget: src/**/*.js excluding canonical-record-writer.js itself and its direct test file
setup.runtimeAuditTarget: all canonical records in StateAdapter state at audit time
adapterPersistPatterns: equivalent StateAdapter canonical-record write calls as identified at audit time

trigger.runAgainst: current working tree + current session adapter state

negative_assertions.condition: no canonical record persistence bypasses writeCanonicalRecord
negative_assertions.description: A call site that persists a canonical record without a preceding writeCanonicalRecord validation in the same lexical scope is a DP-2-I1 defect.

Callers MUST consume the { ok, record, phase } return value and proceed to persist the returned record. Discarding the return and persisting an unvalidated record bypasses the chokepoint even with the validator call present.
Wrapping writeCanonicalRecord in try/catch that swallows DP2NonConformanceError and persists anyway defeats the chokepoint. Audit flags any such pattern as bypass.

Per SME-DP2-P1, context.phase MUST be 'scaffold' | 'production' explicitly. Callers that invoke writeCanonicalRecord without a phase value are defects (the writer already throws TypeError on missing phase, but the audit verifies no caller relies on that throw as runtime behavior).

notes.audit_reframing_origin: post-DP-2.1 landing; writer landed pure-function per CLAUDE.md core-module discipline
notes.expected_call_site_count_hint: As of DP-2.1 landing, persistence is caller-side and sites are enumerated in canonical-record-writer.js design §3.2 (three-state-evaluator terminals; inheritance-cascade NA-1.1/NA-1.3 paths; reactive-engine NA-1.4 path; NotApplicable routing; analyst override). Audit discovers actual sites; hint is for developer orientation only.

scenarios.description: Session with >30% of CAUs Inconsistent triggers OntologyLikelyNonRealistCompatible. Separate threshold condition from NotApplicable (disjunctive OR).

scenarios.description: Session with both thresholds crossed (>40% NotApplicable AND >30% Inconsistent) triggers with 'both' reason, not one or the other.

setup.session: session with 20 CAUs, 9 NotApplicable (45%), 7 Inconsistent (35%), 4 Entailed

scenarios.description: Analyst activates exploratoryMode:true after DP-1 fires. Session continues to Phase 2 and Phase 3. Downstream outputs carry compatibilityDegraded:true in every provenance record.

negative_assertions.description: Once exploratoryMode is set for a session, it cannot be cleared. Persists through all downstream outputs.

scenarios.description: Session with below-threshold outcomes (e.g., 20% NotApplicable, 10% Inconsistent) does NOT fire DP-1. Downstream outputs have compatibilityDegraded:false.

setup.session: session with 20 CAUs, 4 NotApplicable (20%), 2 Inconsistent (10%), 14 Entailed

scenarios.description: Session-level thresholds configurable via session config. Analyst sets stricter thresholds (e.g., 20% NotApplicable, 15% Inconsistent); DP-1 fires at the configured thresholds, not defaults.
Phase 2 property disambiguation receives CAU Logical Signatures as primary input (not pre-computed Domain/Range BFO types). Verify input shape change: Phase 2 input now includes signatures array.

Phase 2 fingerprint matcher: Lexical weight clamped to 0.0. Other five dimensions (Domain BFO, Range BFO, BFO subcategory, Characteristics, allowsInheresIn) retain their D2 baseline weights UNCHANGED. No silent rebalancing — Lexical's 'vacated' weight does NOT redistribute across the remaining five dimensions. Lexical similarity computed and surfaced as advisory evidence but does NOT contribute to disambiguation decisions.

setup.weightVector: default D2 weights with Lexical clamped to 0.0

negative_assertions.description: Two candidate disambiguations tied on all non-lexical dimensions MUST NOT be decided by lexical similarity. Analyst breaks tie via Plausible.

The weight 'vacated' by Lexical going to 0.0 MUST NOT be redistributed across the remaining five dimensions. Other weights retain their D2 baseline values exactly. Full weight rebalancing is deferred to D2.1 per Q-V1.0-8.

scenarios.description: During bounded-fallback iteration, Phase 2 outputs marked provisional:true. After Phase 1 stabilizes, Phase 2 outputs finalize with provisional:false.
Regression: D2 scenarios testing internal Phase 2 logic (fingerprint matching, six-dimension scoring, PD-1 through PD-10 rules) still pass under D1.6. Verify no regressions in core Phase 2 behavior.

setup.d2RegressionScenarios: array of 30 preserved D2 AVC scenarios

scenarios.description: Regression: D2 Phase 3 consistency sandbox behavior unchanged. Axioms extracted once at session start; Phase 3 terminal validation matches pre-D1.6 output byte-for-byte on identical inputs.

setup.d2Phase3Scenarios: array of 12 preserved D2 Phase 3 AVC scenarios

scenarios.description: PROV-O end-to-end run under D1.6 pipeline. 30 CAUs evaluated. Three-state disposition distribution captured. Session completes successfully whether DP-1 fires or not. All DP-2 fields present on all records.

expect.sessionBundle: complete JSON with axiomDictionary, iteration history, DP-1 diagnostic, per-CAU records
